design: Each pair holds a claim reference.md asserts and a minimal negation of it. An instrument scores each text independently for support against the substrate; the paired AUC is the fraction of pairs where the assertion outscores its negation. Negation types vary so that an instrument reading only surface distance is exposed by the type-stratified results: a compressor prices the size of an edit, whether or not the edit changes the truth.

pairs.assertion: Kolmogorov complexity is uncomputable: no algorithm computes K(x) for all x.
pairs.negation: Kolmogorov complexity is computable: an algorithm computes K(x) for all x.

pairs.assertion: K(x) is the length of the shortest program that produces x.
pairs.negation: K(x) is the length of the longest program that produces x.

pairs.assertion: Kolmogorov complexity is machine-independent up to an additive constant.
pairs.negation: Kolmogorov complexity is not machine-independent, even up to an additive constant.

pairs.assertion: Maximum Kolmogorov complexity is achieved by pure noise.
pairs.negation: Maximum Kolmogorov complexity is achieved by highly structured text.

pairs.assertion: Three thousand pages of uniformly random letters have higher K than a three-thousand-page encyclopedia.
pairs.negation: Three thousand pages of uniformly random letters have lower K than a three-thousand-page encyclopedia.

pairs.assertion: Kolmogorov complexity measures generative complexity, not value.
pairs.negation: Kolmogorov complexity measures value, not generative complexity.

pairs.assertion: For computable probability distributions, expected Kolmogorov complexity approximates Shannon entropy.
pairs.negation: For computable probability distributions, expected Kolmogorov complexity does not approximate Shannon entropy.

pairs.assertion: The telos-relative complexity of a document is the length of the shortest document that accomplishes the task.
pairs.negation: The telos-relative complexity of a document is the length of the longest document that accomplishes the task.

pairs.assertion: Under an unspecified telos the seven stratum weights are uniform.
pairs.negation: Under an unspecified telos the seven stratum weights concentrate entirely on Musica.

pairs.assertion: The telos weights across the seven strata sum to one.
pairs.negation: The telos weights across the seven strata sum to seven.

pairs.assertion: A technical proof is near-zero complexity for a specialist and enormous for a novice.
pairs.negation: A technical proof is near-zero complexity for a novice and enormous for a specialist.

pairs.assertion: For a persuading telos the dominant strata are Rhetorica, Musica, and Astronomia.
pairs.negation: For a persuading telos the dominant strata are Arithmetica, Geometria, and Grammatica.

pairs.assertion: For a cataloging telos the dominant strata are Arithmetica and Geometria.
pairs.negation: For a cataloging telos the dominant strata are Musica and Astronomia.

pairs.assertion: The 2x2 classification is first made explicit in Nicomachus's Introduction to Arithmetic.
pairs.negation: The 2x2 classification is first made explicit in Aristotle's Categories.

pairs.assertion: Boethius transmits the fourfold classification into the Latin tradition.
pairs.negation: Boethius rejected the fourfold classification and kept it out of the Latin tradition.

pairs.assertion: Proclus independently attributes the fourfold structure to the Pythagoreans.
pairs.negation: Proclus independently attributes the fourfold structure to the Stoics.

pairs.assertion: Aristotle supplies the discrete-continuous axis but does not combine it with rest and motion.
pairs.negation: Aristotle himself combines the discrete-continuous axis with rest and motion.

pairs.assertion: Arithmetica is discrete quantity at rest.
pairs.negation: Arithmetica is continuous quantity in motion.

pairs.assertion: Musica is number in proportion.
pairs.negation: Musica is magnitude immobile.

pairs.assertion: Astronomia studies magnitude in motion.
pairs.negation: Astronomia studies magnitude at rest.

pairs.assertion: The rest-and-motion axis is not kinematic.
pairs.negation: The rest-and-motion axis is strictly kinematic.

pairs.assertion: In prose, the reader's traversal through the text is its motion: reading-time is the text's temporal dimension.
pairs.negation: In prose, page width is the text's temporal dimension.

pairs.assertion: Boethius's treatment is, by his own admission, an adaptation of Nicomachus.
pairs.negation: Boethius's treatment is, by his own admission, an entirely original work owing nothing to Nicomachus.

pairs.assertion: The framework uses Grammatica in the narrow sense of sentence-level form.
pairs.negation: The framework uses Grammatica in the broad medieval sense covering poetics and literary-ethical criticism.

pairs.assertion: Figures of speech belong to Musica rather than Grammatica.
pairs.negation: Figures of speech belong to Grammatica rather than Musica.

pairs.assertion: Claims in the deductive closure of the substrate have zero marginal complexity.
pairs.negation: Claims in the deductive closure of the substrate have maximal marginal complexity.

pairs.assertion: Rhetorica is measured as the Shannon entropy of the document's curatorial decisions.
pairs.negation: Rhetorica is measured as the proposition count of the document's curatorial decisions.

pairs.assertion: The five canons are operational sub-stages of Rhetorica, not separate top-level strata.
pairs.negation: The five canons are separate top-level strata, not operational sub-stages of Rhetorica.

pairs.assertion: Memoria-as-substrate is not a stratum.
pairs.negation: Memoria-as-substrate is a stratum.

pairs.assertion: CPIDR approximates propositional counting from part-of-speech tags plus about forty adjustment rules.
pairs.negation: CPIDR approximates propositional counting from character counts plus a single compression pass.

pairs.assertion: CPIDR's agreement with human consensus exceeds the human-to-human baseline.
pairs.negation: CPIDR's agreement with human consensus falls far short of the human-to-human baseline.

pairs.assertion: A text with many unrelated assertions is high-Arithmetica and low-Dialectica.
pairs.negation: A text with many unrelated assertions is low-Arithmetica and high-Dialectica.

pairs.assertion: Document architecture is describable without time.
pairs.negation: Document architecture requires time in its very definition.

pairs.assertion: Geometria captures IMRaD structure in papers and stanza patterns in verse.
pairs.negation: Geometria captures syllable stress and metrical feet.

pairs.assertion: Augustine defines musica as the science of well-measured movement.
pairs.negation: Augustine defines musica as the science of the celestial spheres.

pairs.assertion: Rhetorical figures are compressible as short specifications that generate long local patterns.
pairs.negation: Rhetorical figures are incompressible noise with no generating specification.

pairs.assertion: Astronomia's trajectory is a time-series of information intensity over document position.
pairs.negation: Astronomia's trajectory is a static histogram with no positional structure.

pairs.assertion: The prior art leaves the genre-conditional trajectory prior implicit; this framework requires it as an explicit named input.
pairs.negation: The prior art requires the genre-conditional trajectory prior explicitly; this framework leaves it implicit.

pairs.assertion: Wilmot and Keller model suspense as uncertainty reduction over neural representations.
pairs.negation: Wilmot and Keller model suspense as vocabulary growth over document length.

pairs.assertion: Stock content is cheap to specify given the named substrate.
pairs.negation: Stock content is algorithmically random relative to the full context.

pairs.assertion: Original content is algorithmically random relative to the full context.
pairs.negation: Original content is cheap to specify given the named substrate.

pairs.assertion: Intensity is reported as one dominant tag per stratum.
pairs.negation: Intensity is reported as a full twenty-eight-cell cross-tabulation.

pairs.assertion: A full 7x4 cross-tabulation is rejected as the output format.
pairs.negation: A full 7x4 cross-tabulation is required as the output format.

pairs.assertion: Reliability compounds multiplicatively across joint stratum-intensity decisions.
pairs.negation: Reliability improves multiplicatively across joint stratum-intensity decisions.

pairs.assertion: Musica and Astronomia are instances of one UID pattern at two scales.
pairs.negation: Musica and Astronomia are unrelated quantities sharing no theoretical framework.

pairs.assertion: Hopkins is Musica-Original and Astronomia-Implied.
pairs.negation: Hopkins is Musica-Implied and Astronomia-Original.

pairs.assertion: A text conforming to genre expectations at both scales is rhythmically flat and trajectory-flat.
pairs.negation: A text conforming to genre expectations at both scales is maximally marked at both scales.

pairs.assertion: Local UID is grounded in Aylett and Turk 2004.
pairs.negation: Local UID is grounded in Reagan et al. 2016.

pairs.assertion: SCR is raw length divided by the compressed core.
pairs.negation: SCR is the compressed core divided by raw length.

pairs.assertion: Stock maps to a retrievable weight of 1.0.
pairs.negation: Stock maps to a retrievable weight of 0.0.

pairs.assertion: An all-Stock ledger scores RI at exactly 1.0.
pairs.negation: An all-Stock ledger scores RI at exactly 0.0.

pairs.assertion: RI describes the compressed core, not the fraction of the document.
pairs.negation: RI describes the fraction of the document, not the compressed core.

pairs.assertion: Strata overlap on the same sentences, so raw length cannot be partitioned across them.
pairs.negation: Strata partition the document cleanly, so raw length divides exactly across them.

pairs.assertion: Novelty density weights Original at 1.0 and Stock at 0.0.
pairs.negation: Novelty density weights Original at 0.0 and Stock at 1.0.

pairs.assertion: The framework produces principled estimates, not measurements.
pairs.negation: The framework produces exact measurements, not estimates.

pairs.assertion: CPIDR is English-specific: its adjustment rules are calibrated on English.
pairs.negation: CPIDR is language-independent: its adjustment rules apply to any language.

pairs.assertion: A text with zero Original tags across all seven strata is a compilation, not a contribution.
pairs.negation: A text with zero Original tags across all seven strata is a contribution, not a compilation.

pairs.assertion: Compilations are legitimate and necessary.
pairs.negation: Compilations are illegitimate and unnecessary.

pairs.assertion: The formal definitions are proposals, not established theorems.
pairs.negation: The formal definitions are established theorems, not proposals.

pairs.assertion: Implied content follows mechanically from the substrate plus inference rules.
pairs.negation: Implied content is chosen freely from a visible curatorial option space.
